page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this server provides 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, totaling 64 dedicated vCPUs. It features 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in memory bandwidth and parallel processing. The instance achieves a strong rating in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 209.21 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 269.5 GB/sec. Passmark database operations and extended instructions tests also score in the top 25% tier. Conversely, single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and Geekbench fall within the average range, while text generation speeds for small and medium language models are relatively weak, reflecting its lack of hardware acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfc6.16xlarge offers a high-density compute profile without the added expense of bundled local storage or GPU accelerators. The dedicated CPU allocation and strong database operation performance make this instance highly suitable for compute-intensive workloads, multi-threaded data decompression, high-throughput database operations, and parallelized CPU-bound applications that do not require local SSD storage.
